read.thesis: Corteva raised FY26 operating EBITDA to $4.1-4.3B and EPS to $3.60-3.80, but crop protection pricing is falling mid-single digits in H2 on Brazil competition and Brazil credit is tight, with no supply-side capacity signal.

triggers.label: CP H2 pricing cut to mid-single digits down
triggers.quote: we did move pricing for the second half to from low single digits down to mid-single digits down

triggers.label: FY26 EBITDA raised to $4.1-4.3B
triggers.quote: We now expect operating EBITDA of $4.1 billion to $4.3 billion and operating EPS of $3.60 to $3.80 per share

triggers.label: Brazil credit tight for growers
triggers.quote: Credit's tight for the Brazilian farmer right now

triggers.label: Generic pressure from off-patent AIs
